items.label: COMPACT VOLUME
items.value: Kitsure dish rack is suitable for kitchens with limited space. The bottom layer measures only 12''W x 15.5''L and the overall height is 5". The rack is capable of holding 10 plates and other bowls and glasses. With a Kitsure dish rack, you can perfectly save your countertop space.

items.label: PREMIUM MATERIAL
items.value: Kitsure Kitchen dish drying rack has a plastic drainboard and premium rust-proof metal which can effectively prevent rust and deformation. And you can clean the rack easily by rinsing it under a running tap. Tips: Water may not drain smoothly if the sink edge is above the counter.

items.label: EASY INSTALL & CLEAN
items.value: Kitsure dish drainer is easy to install with the attached installation manual. In addition, with the waterproof coating, the rack is also easy to clean. All you need to do is wipe the rack with a damp cloth or rinse it under a running tap after use. The water pipe can also be disassembled for cleaning.

items.label: EASY TO USE
items.value: Kitsure drying rack for kitchen consists of a cutlery holder, a dish rack, and a drainboard set. With such a simple structure, it is easy to install as no tool is needed in the process. the dish rack stays firmly where it is.

items.label: DETACHABLE CUTLERY HOLDER
items.value: The cutlery holder of this dish drying rack is divided into two spaces for cutlery and other small items. With this dish rack, you can always find the right place for various tableware!

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Rotatable Water Outlet, Detachable Cutlery Holder, Slip Resistant
